ZEC.summary: NU7 is about 10 days out (around Nov 5): 25-second blocks, Sprout pool disabled, and 60% of fees taken out of circulation, with node operators told to run Zebra 7.0.0. ZEC is up about 7% today; no vesting unlocks (PoW issuance only), so the main risk is an upgrade slip.

news.title: NU7 roughly 10 days away: Sprout pool to be disabled, operators must run Zebra 7.0.0 before block 3,543,405
Privacy coins ZEC and XMR outperform Bitcoin on the week ahead of NU7, which cuts block time to 25s and sets aside 60% of fees
Zcash devs finalize NU7 mainnet activation height 3,543,405, targeting around Nov 5; ZEC up about 12%

MORPHO.summary: Integrations keep coming and support the long: Robinhood stock tokens as collateral and Ledger wallet loans built on Morpho, plus Morpho driving most recent DeFi stablecoin growth. The risk is about 973K MORPHO stolen from institution-linked wallets that could be sold. No unlocks in the next 14 days.

news.title: Robinhood stock tokens go live as collateral for USDG loans on Morpho; Robinhood Chain TVL reaches $1.14B
Ledger Wallet launches crypto-backed stablecoin loans running on Morpho markets
About 973K MORPHO stolen from two institution-linked addresses and routed to Tornado Cash; no protocol bug confirmed

DOT.summary: Headlines still lean against DOT: the Fearless Wallet key leak, a near-empty relay chain after the Asset Hub move, and CoinShares closing its Stockholm Polkadot staking ETP (last trading ~Nov 4, redemption Nov 9), which could mean some DOT sold. No vesting unlocks; only regular issuance under the hard cap.

news.title: CoinShares to redeem seven Stockholm-listed ETPs including its Polkadot staking product; last trading around Nov 4, redemption Nov 9
Relay chain nearly emptied after the Asset Hub migration; a referendum to rename to JAM fails
Fearless Wallet extension found leaking recovery phrases; users told to move funds after about 17K DOT taken

WCT.summary: Nothing material this week. Monthly unlocks fall on the 15th; the next (Nov 15) is outside the 14-day window.

LIT.summary: Still supportive for the long: a November CFTC license filing, new options and weETH collateral, and nearly all revenue (~$2.8M over 30 days) going to LIT buybacks; it gave back ~9% on Oct 23 with the market. No unlocks in the window; the big team/investor cliff is in late December.

ANIME.summary: No material news this week. Tokenomist shows no unlocks in the next 14 days; the next (to Community Cultivation) is Nov 23, outside the window.

BERA.summary: No material news this week. DefiLlama lists no BERA unlocks scheduled after Oct 25; only ongoing validator and reward-vault emissions, which add a little supply.
